title: Concrete Pump for Masonry and Formwork Filling
seoTitle: Concrete Pump for Masonry Formwork Filling | Pinjin Xingtai
description: Compact Pinjin rows can place grout or fine-stone into masonry cores and formwork when the mix matches the printed aggregate cell. This is not a mortar sprayer and not the secondary-structure column article. B500S lists 10 mm and 5 m / 5 m; Electric 15 lists 8–10 m³/h.

answerBlock.what: Masonry-core grout and formwork filling are placing jobs: the mix must match the printed aggregate cell and the line must be primed. [B500S](/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/) lists 7.5 kW, 5 m / 5 m, sand and small stone 5–16 mm, 280 kg. [Electric 15](/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/) lists 8–10 m³/h, 60–80 m / 15–20 m. This page is not a mortar-sprayer guide — plaster and tile adhesive stay on the sprayer hub. It is also not the secondary-structure column article, which already covers small vertical members. Pinjin does not print a masonry-bond or formwork-pressure certificate.
answerBlock.who: Buyers filling block cores, small formwork or grout pockets who already compared a concrete pump with a mortar sprayer and need the listed fine-stone / compact trailer cells.
factors: Match stone size to the printed aggregate cell (B500S 10 mm)
Do not use a mortar sprayer SKU as a concrete pump substitute
Catalogue m³/h is a factory row, not a masonry-block count
No published formwork-pressure or grout-bond certificate

faqs.question: Is a Pinjin mortar sprayer the right machine to fill masonry cores with grout?
faqs.answer: Usually no. Mortar sprayers on this site are for plaster and mortar spray. Filling cores or formwork with pumpable grout or fine-stone is a placing job. Start from B500S (10 mm, 5 m / 5 m) or Electric 15. See concrete pump vs mortar sprayer. We will not treat a sprayer listing as a core-fill pump.

faqs.question: Does this article replace the secondary-structure column page?
faqs.answer: No. Secondary-structure already covers small columns and infill. This page is masonry cores and formwork filling: match aggregate, prime the line, quote the compact row. Do not duplicate that column-selection table here.

faqs.question: Can Electric 40 fill large formwork faster because it lists 21 m³/h?
faqs.answer: Electric 40 lists 45 kW, 21 m³/h, hopper 0.4 m³, 23 MPa. Those cells are not a formwork-cycle time. If the opening and mix need a smaller hopper and 100–125 mm pipe, Electric 15 may be the listed match. Send form size and mix — unpublished pour clocks are not quoted as factory specs.
